comparison_markers: ## Upstream Delta Since the Previous Pin

delta_decisions.upstream_change: split_mega_files removes built-in fallback person names, so name extraction requires explicit known_names.json configuration instead of matching common names in unrelated content
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork's _load_known_people() in mempalace_code/split_mega_files.py reads optional ~/.mempalace/known_names.json data and returns an empty list when the file is absent or unusable, so extract_people() does not match generic person names by default. tests/test_split_mega_files.py::test_load_known_people_requires_explicit_config pins the no-configuration boundary.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: the range does not alter upstream FIFO or other irregular-file protections; the fork's descriptor-validation boundary remains in force
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork continues to open accepted ingest sources and generated split outputs through descriptors, revalidate them with fstat, refuse symlinks, FIFOs, and hard links, retain the source mega-file after refusal, and exit nonzero.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: Chroma repair corroborates FTS5 content before rebuilding, client-cache bookkeeping stops treating its own writes as external invalidation, and listing and tunnel metadata reads bypass HNSW
delta_decisions.rationale: All three upstream changes operate its Chroma runtime. The fork retains Chroma solely as one-way migration input; LanceDB remains the only runtime backend. Migration smoke and error tests continue to enforce that boundary.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: sqlite_exact vectorizes ranking, hydrates only selected rows, caches facets, and indexes generated wing, room, and hall columns for structured access
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no sqlite_exact runtime backend. Its LanceDB storage and search paths do not import the upstream SQL schema, generated columns, caches, or pagination code.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: embeddinggemma avoids CoreML under automatic selection and validates non-CPU witness vectors for finite, non-zero norm before use
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork supports all-MiniLM-L6-v2 as its default and has no supported embeddinggemma model configuration or migration flow. Importing provider policy without the gated text-retrieval evidence would violate the fork's model policy.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: a background logstream watch adds typed filters, restart-safe event-id checkpoints, bounded idle exit, and interrupt exit status; repeated fixes make malformed, missing, or unreachable checkpoints replay rather than skip events
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork has no logstream, event cursor, replication, or agent wake-up surface. Its existing local watcher independently holds a shared operation lease for its lifetime, handles SIGTERM, restores the prior handler, and releases the lease at shutdown; those protections remain unchanged and are not claimed as logstream compatibility.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: the HTTP peer-sync process publishes a redacted atomic mesh-state snapshot for other local transports to read
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork ships no peer mesh or cross-transport estate, so there is no compatible state file to adopt.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: a stdio MCP session uses a lightweight proxy path and imports the storage server lazily only when local fallback is required
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork ships stdio MCP without the upstream live hub or proxy transport and does not import that execution path.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: the range adds KG supersede, hook-routing, Termux, API, coordination, and performance-test documentation or coverage without a corresponding fork runtime contract
delta_decisions.rationale: These files document or test upstream-only surfaces and do not change a runtime contract imported by the fork.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: three upstream benchmark runners pin UTF-8 file I/O and use ASCII-safe console separators on Windows
delta_decisions.rationale: The fork does not import or publish those upstream benchmark runners.

delta_decisions.upstream_change: upstream advances package and plugin metadata to 3.8.0, guards the OpenClaw skill version, updates actions, and attaches container provenance and SBOM attestations
delta_decisions.rationale: These changes govern upstream-only workflows, container publication, and release metadata. The fork does not import those artifacts.
